name: PDF
author: Anthropic
short_description: Read, write, merge, split, OCR, and fill PDF forms with Claude.
long_description: Complete PDF toolkit for Claude Code. Extract text and tables, combine/split/rotate files, create and fill forms, OCR scanned PDFs, extract images, add watermarks, encrypt/decrypt. Install from anthropic-skills.

name: DOCX
author: Anthropic
short_description: Create, read, and edit Microsoft Word documents (.docx/.dotx).
long_description: Full Microsoft Word document manipulation: extract content, reorganize, insert/replace images, find-and-replace, work with tracked changes and comments, convert content to polished Word files. Handles .docx and .dotx templates.

name: PPTX
author: Anthropic
short_description: Create and edit PowerPoint presentations with Claude.
long_description: Build pitch decks, slide decks, and presentations as .pptx files. Parse existing presentations, extract text and speaker notes, modify layouts, work with templates (.potx), combine or split slide files. Triggers on any .pptx or .potx reference.

name: XLSX
author: Anthropic
short_description: Open, edit, create, and clean spreadsheets (.xlsx, .csv, .tsv).
long_description: Full spreadsheet manipulation: add columns, compute formulas, format cells, build charts, clean messy tabular data, convert between formats. Works with .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, .tsv. Ideal for turning raw data into polished reports.

name: Skill Creator
author: Anthropic
short_description: Create, edit, and benchmark your own Claude Code skills.
long_description: Meta-skill for building skills. Scaffold new skills from scratch, edit and optimize existing skills, run evals, benchmark performance with variance analysis, optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy. The skill that writes skills.

name: Deep Research
author: Anthropic
short_description: Multi-agent research across sources, synthesized into a narrative report.
long_description: Coordinates research subagents to investigate topics across multiple sources, compare options, analyze trends, and synthesize into comprehensive reports. Requires a subagent tool (Agent or Task). Use when a prompt needs substantial research plus narrative synthesis.

name: Data Visualization
author: Anthropic
short_description: Elegant, accessible charts across any library or output format.
long_description: Design-system-agnostic method for charts and dashboards: form heuristic, color palette validator, mark specs, interaction rules. Works in HTML artifacts, React, matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, PNG, or Slack-shared images. Validated palette for light and dark modes.

name: Code Review
author: Anthropic
short_description: Review current diff, PR, or branch for correctness bugs and cleanups.
long_description: Reviews pending changes at configurable effort (low/medium/high/xhigh/max/ultra). Posts inline PR comments with --comment, applies fixes with --fix. Ultra tier spawns multi-agent cloud reviews. Caps findings with --max-findings.

name: Security Review
author: Anthropic
short_description: Complete security audit of pending changes on the current branch.
long_description: Runs a security-focused review on the current branch's diff. Flags OWASP-style issues (injection, auth, crypto, access control), surfaces insecure deserialization, hardcoded secrets, and dependency issues.

name: Claude API Reference
author: Anthropic
short_description: Up-to-date reference for the Claude API and Anthropic SDKs.
long_description: Always-current model IDs, pricing, parameters, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration. Required reading before answering any Claude/Anthropic API question. Triggers on provider names, model IDs, SDK imports.

name: Google Workspace
author: Anthropic
short_description: Create and edit Google Docs, Sheets, Slides via the Drive connector.
long_description: Full Google Workspace manipulation with helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges, slide layout. Create, edit, format, copy, rename files. Loads before any Drive/Docs/Sheets/Slides connector call that changes a file.

name: Schedule (Cron Agents)
author: Anthropic
short_description: Create, list, run scheduled cloud agents on a cron schedule.
long_description: Schedule recurring cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron timer. Set up automated tasks, cron jobs, routine reports. Also supports one-time scheduled runs. Manages existing scheduled agents.

name: Loop
author: Anthropic
short_description: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval.
long_description: Set up recurring tasks, status polling, or interval-based execution. Omit the interval for self-paced dynamic loops. Used for 'check the deploy every 5 minutes' or 'keep running /babysit-prs' style workflows.

name: Plugin Authoring
author: Anthropic
short_description: Build and debug mods — themes, panels, bands, slash commands, hooks.
long_description: Author customizations to Claude's interface and behavior: themes, panes that update, bands, status lines, toasts, slash commands, hooks on tool calls. Full plugin development workflow.

name: Docs (Claude Docs)
author: Anthropic
short_description: Living docs people share, comment on, and co-edit with Claude.
long_description: Default for any document: memos, plans, specs, proposals, resumes, cover letters, letters, contracts, policies, handbooks, guides. Exports to Word, PDF, Markdown, Google Docs. Not for files named by format (.docx) — those go to their dedicated skills.
